title: X-AQA: Unifying Action Quality Assessment with Multimodal Large Language Models and Multi-Domain Learning

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce X-AQA, the first unified training and evaluation framework for general-purpose AQA with multimodal large language models (MLLMs).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to evaluate the quality of human actions, yet existing methods are predominantly developed and evaluated on individual datasets with different task formulations and assessment criteria.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We convert heterogeneous annotations into a unified question-answering format, incorporating dataset-specific annotation guidelines and official scoring rules when available.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We construct X-AQA-40K, a training corpus comprising 40,163 samples from 22 data sources across four domains: competitive sports, fitness exercises, rehabilitation, and general skills.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We further establish X-AQA-Bench, which evaluates both in-distribution (ID) performance on datasets represented during training and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on four held-out datasets.
